services.name: Sunset Cruises
services.desc: At the end of your day a peaceful cruise will let you relax! Whether you are visiting, new to the area, or a local who just wants to remember what a beautiful area we live in, this is a great opportunity to join us aboard RiverQuest and experience the river as we cruise along these unspoiled waters. Enjoy the spectacular beauty as we aimlessly cruise the lower Connecticut River, an area that the Nature Conservancy considers to be “One of the Last Great Places”. On this cruise, about two hours in length, we do only light narration so that you can just relax and enjoy. services.name: Winter Wildlife Eagle Cruise
services.desc: Come out of your winter doldrums and experience the beauty and solitude of the lower Connecticut River during this wonderful time of year! It is so different than it is any other time of the year. There are no other vessels on the water, and with no leaves on the trees, our wildlife viewing is easy and fun. As the river, lakes and ponds to our north freeze, Eagles and others make their way to the lower CT River for their favorite food - FISH. Join us on this approximately 2 hour “on-the-water” cruise to search for eagles and other winter wildlife.
